about.title: I solve technical problems. Code is one of my tools.
about.lead: I've been working as a mechanical design engineer for 7 years. I design in SolidWorks, prepare technical documentation, and work closely with production teams and clients. My day-to-day work involves turning specific requirements into solutions that can be designed and manufactured — even when a standard approach isn't enough.
about.software: I started coding in 2023 by building a website for Fotoroman, showing my father's photography passion. Since then, I've built more applications while developing my skills in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I've also built a website for a client in the renewable energy sector.
about.tools: I also use programming to improve my work as an engineer. I created an Excel template using VBA that my entire team uses to prepare email responses and quotations, as well as a SolidWorks macro that automates PNG visualization exports and sequential numbering. These are the kinds of problems I enjoy solving: repetitive tasks that can be completed faster and more reliably through automation.
about.ai: I'm currently developing projects that combine software, automation, and AI. NEXUS is a project for an AI-powered ticket management platform that uses AI for ticket classification and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to search a knowledge base. I'm particularly interested in building useful AI tools while keeping humans in control of the final decisions.
about.next: I'm looking for opportunities at the intersection of engineering and software — building tools, automating processes, developing AI solutions, or working on engineering software. I want to build on my experience in a real-world engineering environment while continuing to grow as an engineer who can also design and develop software. I'm based in Poznań, Poland, and open to on-site, hybrid, and remote opportunities.
